Si tu sistema pide reducir el movimiento: If your system asks to reduce motion, the test charges draw their trajectory at once instead of animating it.
La descripción y la teoría incluyen ya t: The description and the theory now cover all the sources (sheets, shells, rings, disks, conductors, dipoles…).
El modo práctica comprueba las dimension: Practice mode checks dimensions: if your answer is not in N/C, V, N, J… it tells you, and if you add terms with different units it points out which one fails.
Tubo cilíndrico con carga superficial σ: Cylindrical tube with surface charge σ and hollow cylinders (with an inner radius), to solve coaxial cables.
Densidades que no son uniformes en esfer: Non-uniform densities in spheres and cylinders (ρ₀·r/R, ρ₀·R/r, ρ₀(1 − r/R) and ρ₀(1 − r²/R²)) and in rods (λ that grows or decreases along them), with Gauss and the enclosed charge.
Arcos cargados: semicircunferencias, cua: Charged arcs: semicircles, quarter rings or any angle, with the field and potential at the center.
Corteza esférica conductora con radio in: Conducting spherical shell with inner and outer radius: if there is a centered charge inside, −q is induced on the inner face and +q on the outer one.
